tool_schemas.name: search_contacts
tool_schemas.description: Searches your synced contacts for entries whose display name or JID/phone fragment matches `query`, and returns the matching contacts as a paged list (implementation-defined page size/order). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if `query` is missing or empty, UNAUTHORIZED if there is no active session, and RATE_LIMITED when request limits are exceeded.

query.description: Search term for contact name or phone number part of JID

tool_schemas.name: list_messages
tool_schemas.description: Lists messages for the chat identified by `chat_jid`, returning a single page of up to `limit` messages at `page` (0-indexed). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if `chat_jid` is missing, `limit` is not > 0, or `page` is < 0; NOT_FOUND if the chat does not exist in the synced store; and UNAUTHORIZED or RATE_LIMITED if the session is not available or request limits are exceeded.

chat_jid.description: The JID of the chat (e.g., '123456@s.whatsapp.net' or 'group@g.us')

tool_schemas.name: list_chats
tool_schemas.description: Lists synced chats, optionally filtered by `query`, sorted by `sort_by`, and optionally including each chat’s last message when `include_last_message` is true; results are returned as a page of up to `limit` chats at `page` (0-indexed). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if `limit` is not > 0, `page` is < 0, or `sort_by` is not one of the supported values; and UNAUTHORIZED or RATE_LIMITED if the session is not available or request limits are exceeded.

query.description: Optional filter by chat name or JID

tool_schemas.name: get_chat
tool_schemas.description: Retrieves a single chat by `chat_jid` and, when `include_last_message` is true, includes the chat’s most recent message metadata. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if `chat_jid` is missing, NOT_FOUND if no such chat exists in the synced store, and UNAUTHORIZED or RATE_LIMITED if the session is not available or request limits are exceeded.

chat_jid.description: The JID of the chat to retrieve

tool_schemas.name: get_message_context
tool_schemas.description: Returns a context window of messages surrounding `message_id`, including up to `before` messages preceding and up to `after` messages following the target message (and the target message when available). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if `message_id` is missing or if `before`/`after` are negative, NOT_FOUND if the message does not exist in the synced store, and UNAUTHORIZED or RATE_LIMITED if the session is not available or request limits are exceeded.

message_id.description: The ID of the target message to get context around

tool_schemas.name: send_message
tool_schemas.description: Queues/sends a text message to `recipient` and returns the recorded outbound message with its initial delivery lifecycle state. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if `recipient` is missing or `message` is empty, NOT_FOUND if the recipient chat cannot be resolved/created for the given JID, CONFLICT if the session is not in a state that permits sending, and UNAUTHORIZED or RATE_LIMITED if the session is not available or request limits are exceeded.

recipient.description: Recipient JID (user or group, e.g., '12345@s.whatsapp.net' or 'group123@g.us')

tool_schemas.name: search_messages
tool_schemas.description: Searches message text for `query` across all chats or within `chat_jid` when provided, returning a page of matches of up to `limit` at `page` (0-indexed). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if `query` is missing/empty, `limit` is not > 0, or `page` is < 0; NOT_FOUND if `chat_jid` is provided but the chat does not exist in the synced store; and UNAUTHORIZED or RATE_LIMITED if the session is not available or request limits are exceeded.

query.description: The text content to search for within messages

chat_jid.description: Optional: The JID of a specific chat to search within (e.g., '123...net' or 'group@g.us'). If omitted, searches all chats.

tool_schemas.name: list_contacts
tool_schemas.description: Lists synced contacts for the active WhatsApp account as a paged list, optionally filtered by lifecycle `status` and sorted by `sort_by`. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if `limit`/`page` are out of range or `sort_by`/`status` are unsupported; UNAUTHORIZED if there is no active session; and RATE_LIMITED when request limits are exceeded.

tool_schemas.name: get_contact
tool_schemas.description: Retrieves a single synced contact by `contact_id` for the active WhatsApp account. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if `contact_id` is missing, NOT_FOUND if no such contact exists for the active account, and UNAUTHORIZED or RATE_LIMITED if the session is not available or request limits are exceeded.

contact_id.description: The contact row ID to retrieve

tool_schemas.name: update_contact
tool_schemas.description: Updates a synced contact’s mutable fields and/or lifecycle `status` for the active WhatsApp account. Enforces lifecycle transitions (e.g., cannot move from 'deleted' to any other state). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid payloads or forbidden transitions, NOT_FOUND if the contact does not exist for the active account, CONFLICT if the update cannot be applied due to current state, and UNAUTHORIZED or RATE_LIMITED if the session is not available or request limits are exceeded.

contact_id.description: The contact row ID to update

status.description: New lifecycle status (transition must be allowed)

tool_schemas.name: update_chat
tool_schemas.description: Updates a chat’s mutable fields and/or lifecycle `status` for the active WhatsApp account (e.g., archive/unarchive, delete). Enforces lifecycle transitions (e.g., cannot move from 'deleted' to any other state). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid payloads or forbidden transitions, NOT_FOUND if the chat does not exist for the active account, CONFLICT if the update cannot be applied due to current state, and UNAUTHORIZED or RATE_LIMITED if the session is not available or request limits are exceeded.

chat_jid.description: The JID of the chat to update

status.description: New lifecycle status (transition must be allowed)

tool_schemas.name: get_message
tool_schemas.description: Retrieves a single message by `message_id` for the active WhatsApp account. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if `message_id` is missing, NOT_FOUND if no such message exists for the active account, and UNAUTHORIZED or RATE_LIMITED if the session is not available or request limits are exceeded.

message_id.description: The ID of the message to retrieve

metadata.name: WhatsApp MCP Server
metadata.description: This backend models a WhatsApp client session that syncs chats, contacts, and messages into a local store and exposes read/search tools plus a send-message mutation. Core workflows are: (1) query contacts/chats/messages with paging/sorting, (2) fetch a chat with optional last message, (3) fetch mess
